reading: Countries at COP31 in Turkey failed to agree on a major plan to fight climate change.
Countries disagreed about fossil fuels and money.
Fossil fuels include coal, oil and gas.
The talks were planned to end on Friday, but they continued until Sunday.
The final plan did not mention fossil fuels.
Some countries rejected the plan because it did not mention fossil fuels.
Many poorer countries wanted clear promises of money from richer countries.
They wanted help to deal with the effects of rising temperatures.
The next climate talks are planned for November 2027 in Ethiopia.

vocabulary.definition: Changes in the world's usual weather over a long time.
Coal, oil and gas that people burn for energy.
Meetings where people discuss a problem or plan.
Things that people say they will certainly do.
Take action to help with a problem.

entries.ja: 長い時間をかけて起こる、世界の通常の気象の変化。
entries.ko: 오랜 시간에 걸쳐 일어나는 세계의 평소 날씨 변화.
entries.zh-Hans: 世界通常的天气状况在很长一段时间内发生的变化。
entries.es: Cambios en las condiciones habituales del tiempo en el mundo a lo largo de un período largo.
entries.pt-BR: Mudanças nas condições habituais do tempo no mundo ao longo de um período longo.
entries.fr: Des changements dans les conditions météorologiques habituelles du monde sur une longue période.
entries.de: Veränderungen des üblichen Wetters auf der Welt über einen langen Zeitraum.

entries.ja: 人々がエネルギーを得るために燃やす石炭、石油、ガス。

entries.zh-Hans: 人们为了获取能源而燃烧的煤、石油和天然气。
entries.es: Carbón, petróleo y gas que las personas queman para obtener energía.
entries.pt-BR: Carvão, petróleo e gás que as pessoas queimam para obter energia.
entries.fr: Le charbon, le pétrole et le gaz que les gens brûlent pour obtenir de l’énergie.
entries.de: Kohle, Erdöl und Gas, die Menschen verbrennen, um Energie zu gewinnen.

entries.es: Reuniones en las que las personas hablan sobre un problema o un plan.
entries.pt-BR: Reuniões em que as pessoas discutem um problema ou um plano.
entries.fr: Des réunions où des personnes discutent d’un problème ou d’un projet.

entries.ja: 何かを受け入れないと決めた。
entries.zh-Hans: 作出了不接受某事物的决定。

entries.pt-BR: Coisas que as pessoas dizem que com certeza vão fazer.
entries.fr: Des choses que les gens disent qu’ils feront à coup sûr.
entries.de: Dinge, von denen Menschen sagen, dass sie sie ganz sicher tun werden.

entries.ja: 問題の解決に役立つ行動を取る。
entries.ko: 문제를 해결하는 데 도움이 되는 행동을 하다.
